datasets.name: PlantVillage Dataset
datasets.license: UNRESOLVED at original GitHub source; do not infer from mirrors
datasets.commercial_use: HOLD pending confirmation from the original rights holder
datasets.reported_classes: 38 crop-disease/healthy combinations across 14 crop species and 26 diseases
datasets.capture_conditions: controlled/lab-style leaf images; source README does not provide a field geography
datasets.label_evidence: source README and cited Mohanty et al. dataset description
datasets.download_size: mirror-specific; TFDS documentation reports 827.82 MiB download for its republished copy
limitations: original GitHub repository has no dataset license file
Kaggle/Hugging Face terms must not be assumed to apply to original images

datasets.name: PlantDoc Cropped Dataset
datasets.license: CC BY 4.0 for the repository release; underlying scraped-image rights require review
datasets.commercial_use: CONDITIONAL; verify image-level rights and attribution requirements
datasets.reported_classes: 13 plant species and up to 17 disease classes; exact class-to-crop mapping requires downloaded-tree audit
datasets.capture_conditions: internet-sourced, non-laboratory images with varied backgrounds
datasets.label_evidence: repository README and PlantDoc paper description
datasets.download_size: not published on the repository page
limitations: class distribution and image-level rights need local audit

datasets.name: RiceLeafDiseaseBD
datasets.commercial_use: Generally permitted with attribution; verify current record terms before release
datasets.capture_conditions: smartphone field images from Gazipur, Dhaka, Bangladesh; Summer 2025; BRRI dhan28/dhan29 focus
datasets.label_evidence: dataset page reports manually drawn annotations, expert validation, 21460 boxes, and Cohen kappa 0.82
datasets.download_size: not exposed on the public landing page; record after download
limitations: object-detection boxes require crop/condition extraction policy
Bangladesh geography may not represent all target regions

datasets.name: Image Dataset on Chili Leaf Diseases in the Krishna River Basin
datasets.commercial_use: Generally permitted with attribution; verify current record terms before release
datasets.capture_conditions: field images from Karnataka and Andhra Pradesh, India; October 2024 to February 2025; natural daylight
datasets.label_evidence: dataset page reports expert-supervised collection and cross-validation by plant pathologists
datasets.download_size: not exposed on the public landing page; record after download
limitations: generic leaf spot cannot be assumed equivalent to Cercospora leaf spot
nutrition deficiency is not a pest/disease class

datasets.name: MGLeaf-Disease
datasets.commercial_use: Generally permitted with attribution; verify current record terms before release
datasets.capture_conditions: dataset landing page describes real-time mango and groundnut leaf images; detailed geography not published on the landing page
datasets.label_evidence: dataset page lists class directories and reports 91438 images in version 1; version 2 removes the physical split
datasets.download_size: not exposed on the public landing page; record after download
limitations: two mango healthy labels need evidence-based reconciliation
early/late leaf spot must not be merged into tikka without agronomic evidence
reported total originates from version 1 description and must be verified against version 2 files
